title: Replication package for "Ranking Well, Deciding Badly: Disentangling Score Ranking from Cut-off Placement in Cross-Day Flow-Sequence Intrusion Detection"
description: Code, per-run results (SQLite), derived analysis tables, supplemental tables S1-S14, and public editions of the registered analysis plan for an audit of fixed 0.5 cut-off evaluation in cross-day flow-sequence network intrusion detection on CIC-IDS2017, CSE-CIC-IDS2018 and NF-UNSW-NB15. Raw datasets and per-sequence score files are not included; see README.md.
